name: Big-five early-season previous-season carryover replication v1
purpose: Untouched replication of the already specified carryover formula on a different season.

carryover_rule.team_history: Use all earlier current-season results. If fewer than eight, prepend the most recent previous-season results for the same team in the same top-flight league, within 180 days, until eight total are available.
carryover_rule.venue_history: For last-up-to-five home or away shot histories, use earlier current-season venue matches first and continue backward into the immediately previous same-league season within 180 days.
carryover_rule.player_history: Use the previous five starts for the same player and same team within 180 days, crossing the season boundary when available.
carryover_rule.promoted_or_transferred: Do not substitute lower-division team history or a player's different-team history. Missing comparable history remains an exclusion.
carryover_rule.timing: Only matches ending before the target fixture's greater-than-24-hour cutoff may enter features.

pattern_A: Stronger home overall and last five PPG; home venue shots >=12; away venue shots conceded >=12; projected home shots > projected away; confirmed home starter; top two eligible shooters; prior five-start average minutes >=70; at least 4/5 prior 2+ shot hits.
pattern_B: Pattern A plus prior five-start average shots >=3 and average minutes >=80.

betting.rollover: continuous all-in in chronological selection order; a loss reduces the current balance to zero

decision_policy: No threshold, league, weekend, history rule, odds, exclusion or ordering changes after acquisition. Save every target starter, exclusion, environment and pick.
limits: This replication was selected after the 2026 carryover replay, so it is new data but not a prospective trial.
FotMob provider definitions require validation and may differ from StatsBomb or SportsAPI.
Historical market odds are not used; fixed prices are hypothetical.
Actual historical starting lineups are treated as known at lineup time.
